rows.text: Holds the seat, and people accept it; there is room to act, not just to hold on.
Holds the seat with the council beside it; in quiet times the work is the ordinary business.
Holds the seat; the market days run and the dues come in.
Holds the seat; quarrels that need judging go to the court.
Holds the seat, and in a place this small everyone knows it; most quarrels end at its door.
Holds the seat in good years; the place is comfortable, and the seat's costs are met.
Holds the seat; there is enough coin for the everyday work, if little over.
Holds the seat while the place sends out {export} and coin comes back; there is room to act.
Holds the seat in a quiet season; there is time to act.
Commands those under arms in quiet times; the work is keeping trouble from starting.
Commands {house} in quiet times: the drill, the roster and the gear kept ready.
Commands those under arms in quiet times; the walls are walked, and little more is asked.
Commands those under arms in quiet times; most days the work is the market crowds and the odd brawl.
Commands those under arms in a large place at peace; the work is many small quarrels, not one big one.
Keeps those under arms ready in a quiet season; nothing calls on them but routine.
Commands those under arms while the place is quiet; the work is the rounds, the roll and the pay.
Commands those under arms in quiet times; the hard part is keeping idle hands sharp.
Leads the faith in quiet times, whatever it thinks of the seat beside it.
Leads the faith from {house}; in quiet times the work is the services, the feast days and the burials.
Leads the faith across a large place, where its people are too many for one priest to know.
Leads the faith in a small place, where the priest knows every family by name.
Leads the faith in an ordinary year: services, feast days, weddings and burials.
Leads the faith while the place is at peace; the work is the round of services and the needs of the poor.
Leads the faith in a settled season, with no crisis to call the faithful together.
Runs a smaller house behind the leading one in quiet times.
Keeps {house} going in quiet times, a smaller house behind the leading one in the trade.
Runs a smaller house behind the leading one, in a place that sends out {export}.
Runs a smaller house in the trade, second to the leading one, in a steady season.
Runs one of the many smaller houses of a large place, behind the leading one in the trade.
Runs a smaller house behind the leading one; it keeps its own regulars on market days.
Runs a smaller house in the guild, behind the leading one, in a steady season.
Heads the leading house in the trade in quiet times; its hold is secure and its say is real.
Heads {house}, the leading house in the trade, in a steady season.
Heads the leading house in a trade that sends {export} out of the place.
Heads the leading house in the trade of a large place, with many smaller houses behind it.
Heads the leading house in the trade while business is steady and no one presses it.
Holds an office that runs from day to day, with no crisis to answer.
Keeps {house} for the seat, day to day, with no crisis to answer.
Holds a post under the council; the work is the daily round, and the round is quiet.
Holds a small post of the seat and does its daily work; nothing out of the ordinary is asked of it.
Holds a post of the seat whose busiest days are market days.
Holds a post of the seat in good years, when the work is steady and the purse sound.
Heads the casters in quiet times; their place is secure and their spells are in demand.
Heads {house} in quiet times; the work is the ordinary run of spellwork.
Heads the casters of a large place, where there is call for spells every day.
Heads the casters in good years, when people can afford to pay for spellwork.
Heads the casters in a quiet season; the work is the ordinary run of charms and wards.
Heads an old family while the seat's offices take up more of what the family once did.
Heads an old family whose name still opens doors here.
Heads an old family among many in a large place, where an old name opens doors but does not rule.
Holds the seat in name, but fewer people come when called, and some orders go unanswered.
Holds the seat, but the council no longer moves when it asks, and some orders go unanswered.
Holds the seat in name; in a place this small everyone sees who no longer comes when called.
Holds the seat in name; when it calls the neighbours out, fewer come than used to.
Holds the seat, but its word now carries only as far as people choose to let it.
Holds the seat while money is short, and people judge the seat by what it can no longer pay for.
Holds the seat while money is short, in a place that lives on what it gets for its {export}.
Holds the seat while money is short, and {import} must still be bought in at whatever it costs.
Holds the seat in a small place gone short of coin, where everyone knows what has gone unpaid.
Holds the seat while money is short, and every council meeting comes back to the same few coins.
Holds the seat in lean years, and every cost it asks is counted.
Leads the faith while money is short; its lands and alms are both a help and a target.
Leads the faith from {house} while money is short, and more people come to its door for alms.
Leads the faith in a small place gone short of coin, where the priest knows which households are going without.
Leads the faith through lean years, when people lean on it more and give it less.
Leads the faith while the seat fails, and people bring it the quarrels the seat no longer settles.
Leads the faith while the seat fails; more disputes now end at {house} than at the seat's door.
Leads the faith while fewer heed the seat, and more ask the faith to settle what the seat once did.
Leads the faith while many doubt the seat's right, and the seat wants its blessing.
Leads the faith from {house} while many doubt the seat's right; both sides listen for what is said there.
Leads the faith while the seat's right is in doubt, and people wait to hear which way it leans.
Holds the seat, but many doubt its right to it, and the doubt has not gone away.
Holds the seat while many question its right, and the questions are asked openly.
